{{Top|canon=Xenophobia}}
[[File:Rally.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] rallies represented the speciesist attitudes of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].]]
{{Quote|With the way the Empire treats non-Humans, it's a wonder you're not operating a garbage scow somewhere.|[[Tyber Zann]], to Grand Admiral [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>}}
'''Speciesism''', also known as '''xenocentric chauvinism''' and '''racism''',<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref> was a belief that one [[Species/Legends|species]] was inherently superior to another or all other species. Similarly, it manifested itself in '''xenophobia''', an overwhelming fear of and hate against other species, regardless of circumstance.

==Overview==
{{Quote|Your xenocentric chauvinism is no concern of mine. I care about performance and results, and your record is exemplary. I do not care about your petty bigotry. Understood?''"<br />"''Understood, Captain.''"<br />"''Oh, but Commander, if I ever find out that your bigotry ''is'' affecting your performance, I'll have your carcass ejected with the next garbage load.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and the [[Vengeance II|''Vengeance'']] Commander|audio=XenocentricChauvinism-DFSFTE.flac|<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:Thrawn-FF5.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo's]] rise to the position of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] was an aberration, due to the speciesist policies of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].]]
Speciesism was found in cultures across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for various reasons, ranging from religious beliefs to a sense of biological superiority possessed by individuals or groups; indeed, the practice could range from single individuals to an entire [[Species/Legends|species]]. Some species, like the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] and the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]], were mildly xenophobic, but strove to overcome this trait in order to work with different beings. Others, like the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], considered themselves inherently superior, but still often managed to work alongside other species. Some believed [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]] to be speciesist due to their extreme determination and willpower, although this was not true. The [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] were also xenophobic, due to their experience with being mistreated by the Gran, the first off-worlders they ever encountered. Still others, like the [[Ssi-ruu]]k, the [[Yevetha]], and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], considered all other species to be abominations.

An especially prevalent type of speciesism was [[Humanocentrism]]. A notable [[Human/Legends|Human]] speciesist was [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who considered all non-pure Human lifeforms to be disgusting and inferior, yet he reserved a measure of respect towards the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]].<ref name="ROTSNovel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] displayed burgeoning specieist toward other species, such as the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]],<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]],<ref name="Deep forest">{{StoryCite|story=Deep Forest|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref> [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]],<ref name="General Grievous 1">[[General Grievous 1|''General Grievous'' 1]]</ref> and [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]].<ref name="General Grievous 2">[[General Grievous 2|''General Grievous'' 2]]</ref> In response to such sentiments, [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] sometimes formed [[Anti-Humanism|anti-Human]] sentiments.<ref name="X-W:W'sG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> Although the [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was not himself speciesist, he nonetheless encouraged it in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] due to viewing it as facilitating his control over the galaxy.<ref name="BoS:SotDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> It was thanks to speciesism that Palpatine appealed to [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] early in his career, given Tarkin's Humanocentrism tendencies.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

[[File:NolaaTarkona.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Nolaa Tarkona]]'s [[Diversity Alliance]] was formed to resist speciesism, though they, in turn, reviled Humans.]]
Indeed, at its height, the Galactic Empire was notable for its many speciesist policies and attitudes to certain worlds with non-Human populations. On planets such as [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], the homeworld of the [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]], the Empire legitimized the enslavement of non-Humans. By the time of the reign of Emperor [[Roan Fel]], however, such policies had [[Anti-speciesism|ended]], as evidenced by the presence of non-Human [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].

Although the Empire was notorious for its speciesist views (Imperial officers, soldiers and crews were by 99% humans, and suspicious to aliens<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>), there were at least some traces of speciesism within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], such as Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] referring to the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] as "a walking carpet" during her [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue]] from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Even other non-Imperials individuals were speciecist such as the youngester [[Mace Towani]], who despectively treated the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]]s upon first coming across them with his little sister [[Cindel Towani|Cindel]], calling them names like "mop-face" or "little [[Bear/Legends|bear]]s" until he started to befriend them.<ref name="CoC:AEA">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>

In contrast, speciesism was a foreign concept to the [[Ebruchi]], since they lacked roots and rejected mythology.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
